summary.en: A changing electric field creates a changing magnetic field and vice versa, and this self-sustaining pair propagates through space as an electromagnetic wave, including visible light.
summary.et: Muutuv elektriväli tekitab muutuva magnetvälja ja vastupidi, ning see üksteist ülal hoidev paar levib ruumis elektromagnetlainena, mille hulka kuulub ka nähtav valgus.
